Code has long had git: the history of every line, branches, review, merge. Ideas never had any of that. And when agents launch dozens of runs and review hundreds of papers overnight, knowledge without versions turns into noise.

We built for research what git became for code: every idea, run and number comes with its history, its checks and its author.
